purpose: Published HistFactory workspaces that ship with the package and the explicit channel maps that join native SimpleAnalysis yield files to them. A map is a complete assignment of every workspace channel to a named native region (with an optional flavour mask) or to null, a declared zero signal. sa2json_native refuses a workspace whose channel set no selected map covers exactly; a map never substitutes for an acceptance validation.

publication.title: Search for chargino-neutralino production with mass splittings near the electroweak scale in three-lepton final states in sqrt(s)=13 TeV pp collisions with the ATLAS detector

workspace.acquisition: HEPData resources tab, Likelihoods archive, fetched 2026-08-28

signal_patches.name: ERJR_300p0_100p0
signal_patches.note: one of 64 patches of the published patch set

channel_maps.coverage: all four workspace channels: the low-mass and ISR signal regions and their control regions
channel_maps.region_source: Native output regions carry the publication region names SRlow, SRISR, CRlow and CRISR; each workspace channel joins the region of the same name without its _cuts suffix.
notes: A naming join of the publication regions; it does not validate the native acceptance or the control-region yields.

publication.title: Searches for electroweak production of supersymmetric particles with compressed mass spectra in sqrt(s)=13 TeV pp collisions with the ATLAS detector

channel_maps.coverage: 32 slepton signal regions (ee and mm flavour masks, eight MT2 bins, high and low MET band) and the six control regions (VV, tau, top; high and low MET band)
channel_maps.region_source: Signal channels SR{ee|mm}_eMT2{a-h}_{hghmet|lowmet}[_V2]_cuts join native regions SR_S_{high|low}_eMT2{a-h} with the flavour mask is{ee|mm}; control channels CR{VV|tau|top}_MT2_{hghmet|lowmet}_cuts join CR_S_{VV|tau|top}_{high|low} and carry no flavour mask (the ee, mm, e-mu and mu-e events are combined).

control_region_definition.interval_policy: strict/open, matching the native signal-region convention
control_region_definition.different_flavour_mass_floor: none supplied by Table 2; no additional floor invented

notes: A missing control-region branch in a yield file is an error, never a zero.
